# Analyze S6 performance by DOY window
trips = tables['trips']

# Filter S6 only
s6 = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Calculate yt_per_angler
s6['yt_per_angler'] = s6['yt'] / s6['anglers']

# Group by DOY ranges and class
doy_ranges = [
    (1, 50, 'Early Spring'),
    (51, 100, 'Mid Spring'),
    (101, 150, 'Late Spring'),
    (151, 200, 'Early Summer'),
    (201, 250, 'Mid Summer'),
    (251, 286, 'September'),
    (287, 335, 'October-Nov')
]

print("S6 Performance by Window:")
for doy_min, doy_max, label in doy_ranges:
    window = s6[(s6['fish_date_doy'] >= doy_min) & (s6['fish_date_doy'] <= doy_max)]
    if len(window) > 0:
        print(f"\n{label} (doy {doy_min}-{doy_max}): {len(window)} trips")
        print(f"  THREE_QUARTER: {window[window['cls']=='three_quarter']['yt_per_angler'].mean():.3f} avg")
        print(f"  DAY_1_5: {window[window['cls']=='day_1_5']['yt_per_angler'].mean():.3f} avg")
        print(f"  OVERNIGHT: {window[window['cls']=='overnight']['yt_per_angler'].mean():.3f} avg")

# My S6 trips
my_trips = [101, 102, 107, 108, 109, 112, 113, 114, 115, 156]
print("\n\nMy S6 Bookings:")
for doy in my_trips:
    trip = s6[s6['fish_date_doy'] == doy]
    if len(trip) > 0:
        t = trip.iloc[0]
        print(f"  d{doy}: {t['cls']} - {t['yt']} yt / {t['anglers']} anglers = {t['yt_per_angler']:.3f} yt/angler")
